description: Submit a free numeric (or JSON) answer to a poll by slug. Numbers are aggregated. Strings, booleans, and null are stored only. Poll unlock $1. Asker posts $1–$5. Reader unlock $1. Answers are free.

value.description: Poll answer. A number is included in the aggregates. A string, boolean, or null is stored and left out of the mean, median, and histogram.

name: submit_answer
